paite: Jakob, Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Kris sikha in, Nam Sawm leh Nih dalhte chibai a buk hi.
english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

paite: Ka unaute aw, na ginna uh zeetnain kuhkalna a siam chih theiin, khemna chiteng na tuah chiang un, kipahna ngenin sim un,
english: Count it all joy, my brothers The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” , when you fall into various temptations,

paite: Hiai, na ginna zeetna un kuhkalna a siam chih theiin.
english: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

paite: Huan, bangmah tasam loua na kim ua, na pum ua na bit theihna ding un, kuhkalna in semkim hen.
english: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

paite: Na lak ua kuapeuhin pilna a taksap leh, mi tengteng kianga tai lou leh it loua pepa Pathian tuh ngen hen, huchiin a kiangah piaka hi ding hi.
english: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach; and it will be given to him.

paite: Himahleh, ginglel het louin ginna neiin ngen hen, ginglelmi tuh tuipi kihot huih mutleng leh sep banga hi ngala.
english: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

paite: Huchibang min tuh Toupa kiangah bangmah muh kiging kei hen.
english: For let that man not think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

paite: Lungsim det neilou tuh a thilhih tengtengah a kip kei hi.
english: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

paite: Unau daikilkala om, pahtawia a om jiakin kipak hen;
english: But let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

paite: Mihau tuh, hihneua a om jiakin kipak jaw hen; loupa pak banga a man ding jiakin.
english: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

paite: Ni a hongsuaka huihlum tak a hongnunin loupa tuh a vuaisaka; huai pak tuh a kia a; a omdan hoih tuh a mangthang hi; huchibang maha mihau tuh a paina a vuai ding ahi ngala.
english: For the sun arises with the scorching wind, and withers the grass, and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So also will the rich man fade away in his pursuits.

paite: Khemna thuak teitei mi a hampha hi; zeeta om nungin hinna lallukhu, Toupan amah itte kianga achiam a muh ding jiakin.
english: Blessed is the man who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to those who love him.

paite: Kuamahin, khemna a tuah laiin, Pathian khem ka hi, chi kei hen. Pathian tuh gitlouha khem vual ahi kei, aman leng kua mah a khem ngei kei hi.
english: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

paite: Mi chih amau utnaa pimang leh hipa a om un, khemna a tuak uh ahi jaw hi.
english: But each one is tempted, when he is drawn away by his own lust, and enticed.

paite: Huan, utnain nou a paia, gilou a hongpichinin sihna a suak sak jel hi.
english: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin; and the sin, when it is full grown, brings forth death.

paite: Ka nau deihtakte aw, khemin om kei un.
english: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

paite: Thilpiak hoih leh thil piak buching tuh tunglama kipana vakte Pa kianga kipana hongsuk ahi a, amahah tuh lamdanna leh kiheina lim himhim a om theikei hi.
english: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.

paite: A thilsiamte makaite I honghih theihna dingin, amah deihlamin thutak lakah a honsuak sak ahi.
english: Of his own will he brought us forth by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

paite: Unau deihtakte aw, huaite na thei uhi; himahleh, mi chih ngaihkhiak kilawp henla, thugen kituhpih kei henla, heh hak leh:
english: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

paite: Mihing thangpaihna in Pathian diktatna a bawl ngal kei a.
english: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

paite: Huaijiakin, nin tengteng leh gilou dimval koih mang unla, thu tuh, na kha uh hondam thei, thunuai lut takin pom un.
english: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls or, preserve your life. .

paite: Himahleh, noumau kikhemin ngaikhete kia hi louin thujuite honghi jaw un.
english: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

paite: Kuapeuh thu ngaikhia hi a, jui hi tuan lou tuh, mi limlanga a pianpih maitang hoih taka kien bang phet tuh ahi.
english: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

paite: Hoih takin a kiena, a pai manga, mi bang chi ahia a hih chih a kimangngilh nawn pah ngal hi.
english: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh dan kim, noplenna dan tuh, vela, huchibanga om gigea, ngaikhiaa, mangngilhnawn maimah nak bang hi loua, juia na sem gige hi jaw tuh, huai mi tuh a thilhih ah vual jawlin a om ding hi.
english: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom, and continues, not being a hearer who forgets, but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

paite: Kuapeuh sabiak limsak hia kigingtaa a lei veng hoih loua, amah lungtang kikhemjaw tuh huai mi sabiak dan tuh bangmah ahi kei hi.I Pathian leh Pa mitmuha sabiak siangthou leh gilou pang lou jaw hiai ahi, tagah leh meithaite gimthuak laia veh leh, khovel buahna bang loua kibawl jel.
english: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

paite: I Pathian leh Pa mitmuha sabiak siangthou leh gilou pang lou jaw hiai ahi, tagah leh meithaite gimthuak laia veh leh, khovel buahna bang loua kibawl jel.
english: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
